note: Rewritten from Sands' English revision of 1959 (Amitermes braunsi Fuller); the original description is in Fuller 1922, South African Journal of Natural History 3(2): 70-131 (as Hamitermes braunsi, Willowmore, South Africa). The alate measurements are mostly single values (only a few given as ranges); the soldier is described elsewhere in the same work.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: posterior margin of the head nearly semicircular; fontanelle as large as or larger than the ocelli, extending forwards as a narrow pale band, partly depressed or nearly flat, its centre distinctly behind the line joining the posterior margins of the compound eyes; compound eyes about as long as the postclypeus; ocelli large and wide, oval, separated from the compound eye by slightly less than their own width; postclypeus slightly longer than half its width, inflated, anterior margin straight, posterior margin evenly convex.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Female: body colour indeterminate owing to fading of old specimens. Posterior margin of the head nearly semicircular; fontanelle as large as or larger than the ocelli, with a narrow pale extension forwards, partly depressed or nearly flat, its centre distinctly behind the line joining the posterior margins of the compound eyes; compound eyes about as long as the postclypeus; ocelli large, wide, oval, the distance to the compound eye slightly less than their own width; postclypeus slightly more than half as long as wide, inflated, anterior margin straight, posterior margin evenly convex; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 4, segments 4 and 5 about equal in length. Pronotum narrower than the head (including the compound eyes), anterior margin straight, sides broadly rounded, converging posteriorly to a wavy posterior margin. Male as the female except for a slightly larger fontanelle. Measurements: head width (including compound eyes) 1.00, greatest diameter of the compound eye 0.24, ocellus 0.09×0.13, ocellus–eye distance 0.07—0.08, pronotum width 0.78, length 0.47, hind tibia length 0.97—1.00, forewing length 9.6.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Third marginal tooth of the left mandible projecting beyond the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth.
